mapping_diagnosis.distinguishing_reason: The story explicitly shows the farmer counting five seeds and understanding one-to-one correspondence (n1), then merging two seeds into one hole (n2), with the enabling relation (e1) clearly demonstrated by the temporal order and causal link. This is observably better than a story that merely mentions counting without showing the correspondence, or that merges quantities without prior counting. The mapping is precise and avoids any forbidden terms like 'addition'.
